Integrity Impact: Leave requests could reference non-existent users if user_id was altered or created without valid staff
Remediation Applied: Added DDL trigger trg_fk_leave_requests_user_insert/update in migration 036 and added idx_leave_requests_user

Integrity Impact: Direct fee payments could orphan payment ledger records if student ID was invalid
Remediation Applied: Added DDL trigger trg_fk_fee_payments_student_insert/update in migration 036 and added idx_fee_payments_student

Integrity Impact: Sport curriculum categories could orphan if sports were created or altered without FK trigger
Remediation Applied: Added DDL trigger trg_fk_syllabus_categories_sport_insert/update in migration 036 and added idx_syllabus_categories_sport

Integrity Impact: Full table scan on inventory assignment audit logs and student equipment returns
Remediation Applied: Created indexes idx_equipment_assignment_equipment, idx_equipment_assignment_student, idx_equipment_assignment_staff in migration 036

Integrity Impact: Slow scan lookup for duplicate attendance prevention queries and kiosk device logs
Remediation Applied: Created idx_smart_att_logs_student, idx_smart_att_logs_device, idx_smart_att_logs_batch in migration 036

Integrity Impact: Staff members could inadvertently be assigned overlapping shifts on the same day leading to invalid payroll hours
Remediation Applied: Added DDL triggers trg_prevent_shift_overlap_insert and trg_prevent_shift_overlap_update in migration 036

Integrity Impact: Risk of students enrolled in multiple active batches simultaneously causing scheduling and fee calculation anomalies
Remediation Applied: Enforced via partial unique index idx_student_single_active_batch on student_id WHERE status = "active"

Integrity Impact: Risk of double-counting student attendance sessions and syllabus technique evaluations
Remediation Applied: Enforced via composite UNIQUE constraint on (attendance_id, student_id) and session date-batch uniqueness

Integrity Impact: Risk of generating multiple payroll periods for the same month resulting in double salary disbursement
Remediation Applied: Enforced via UNIQUE constraint on (academy_id, year_month) and staff_salary_statements UNIQUE (payroll_period_id, user_id)

Integrity Impact: Future employee compensation updates could retroactively modify historical financial statements
Remediation Applied: Salary engine stores calculation_snapshot JSON blob and frozen base_rate at statement generation time; audited by regression suite

Integrity Impact: Event participant badges or passes could be generated for unreferenced events or deleted students
Remediation Applied: Enforced via foreign keys with ON DELETE CASCADE to events and students, backed by event_passes foreign key to event_participants

Integrity Impact: Issuing more items than available or negative quantity stock records
Remediation Applied: CHECK constraint available_quantity >= 0 and transactional issuance decrementing available_quantity and logging assignment

Integrity Impact: Cross-tenant data leakage if queries share connection or omit tenant filters
Remediation Applied: Physical database-per-tenant architecture guarantees OS-level file isolation; academy_id column present across all tables for secondary assurance

Integrity Impact: Inserting "karate" vs "Karate" creates fragmented syllabus and batch taxonomies
Remediation Applied: Unique index idx_sports_name_unique ON sports(name COLLATE NOCASE), with lookup and update handling in AcademySetupWizardService

Integrity Impact: SQLite ALTER TABLE ADD COLUMN does not support inline foreign key definitions, leaving newly added columns without schema-level FK checks
Remediation Applied: Migration 036 creates compensating SQLite triggers (INSERT & UPDATE) that validate foreign keys against parent tables
